text:
kai: Quick thread (5m): I'm designing the logs -> audit link UX for automatic fallback decisions. Focus: discoverability, TTLs, and searchable metadata. Thoughts?
jihoon: High level: emit tiny decision_meta into logs (cheap), store full decision_blob separately behind auth. decision_id must be stable and short. Avoid eager full fetches on list pages.
anita: UX: inline mini-chip `fallback` or `primary` on request row. Click opens a right-rail micro-panel with 3 sections: summary sentence, key facts (trigger, latency delta, cost hint), and actions (open full audit, copy id, flag). Add TTL label: "audit link expires in 86 days".
maria: For search we need these indexed in ES: decision_id, trigger_code, chosen_route, billed_on, tenant_id. Also add a boolean `fallback_error` when fallback failed.
jihoon: Sampling: tenant.sample_rate default 1%, tenant.compliance=true forces full capture. Also support `rollout.capture=true` to fully capture during canaries. API: GET /v1/decisions/{id}?view=meta|blob. meta is ~200B, blob varies. Auth: full blob requires auditor/operator role.
kai: Billing question: show both attempted_model and served_model in the audit. Product prefers billed_on_served by default; leave an account-level toggle to bill on requested model for legacy customers. Include `cost_breakdown` in the blob.
anita: Microcopy options for message UI (short, accessible): - "Response shortened to meet latency" - "Content withheld for safety" - "Rerouted to lower-cost variant" Use icons + text to avoid relying on color only.
maria: Retention defaults proposal: meta 90d, blob 365d archived if compliance flag set. Provide tenant TTL in settings and show expiry on UI. Archive retrieval should be a logged, time-limited download.
jihoon: Operator override policy: do NOT mutate original decision_blob. Append override_event that references decision_id and records operator_id, reason, and new_route. CLI: `rictl decision get <id> --view=meta|blob|with-overrides`.
ops-bot: Deployed: decision-meta-endpoint v2.1 by jihoon  migration: add decision_id index and meta view.
kai: Example compact meta (for UI indexing):
```json
{ "decision_id":"dec-20260402-42", "trigger":"p95_latency","code":"P95>1800ms","chosen":"redwood-4b-q","billed_on":"redwood-4b-q","sampled":false }
```
jihoon: Implementation note: include a short `human_reason` under 120 chars in meta so UI can render sentences without extra translation lookups. e.g., "Rerouted: model timeout -> fallback".
anita: Edge case: if blob archived, show an "archived" badge + link to request archive flow. Also show when audit link will expire and a small tooltip "why archived".
maria: Search UX: let ops filter by trigger_code and by sampled=true to find full captures. Also allow deterministic capture for a request_id to force full blob for debugging.
kai: Action items: anita mock the right-rail micro-panel and TTL affordance, jihoon finalize meta/blob schemas + auth rules, maria draft indexing + retention costs, I'll write a short PRD and share in rollout docspace today. :thumbsup:
